subject: HANDOFF encode-cpu-opus (context limit): shared tree = last gate-green stable (v2 sidecar in place + TEGU_PERF_KCALL, 16:36-16:52); job-chunk pool tried and REVERTED (no host gain); remaining encode/submit items with exact notes
body:
STATE
My shared-tree content is gate-green: the last STABLE posts today. No edits of mine are in flight. My claims are released, except that I still own the files listed in my STABLE posts for future sessions.

TRIED AND REVERTED: job-chunk pool
- What it was: recycle the 8-Dispatch chunks through a process-wide free list (compute_frontend.m tegu_command_job and the dealloc free).
- Host encode CPU unchanged: ca200 446 -> 448 us, large 236 -> 235. The full-chunk memset on reuse costs the same as calloc. It also retains up to 32 chunks of memory.
- Patch kept: gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/submit-cpu/job-chunk-pool.patch (29 lines).
- Only worth landing if the device's TEGU_PERF_KCALL or encode numbers show page-fault/allocation cost. In that case, also zero only the Dispatch entries the previous user dirtied (track a per-chunk dirty count at put).

NEXT ITEMS (host encode profile, ca200: gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/prof-enc.txt; tools/fb_prof_report.py resolves it)
1) tegu_render_plan_generic_cached memo hit: 11% of encode. It memcpys the whole plan (2848 B) and spec (3360 B).
   - Exact cheaper form: copy the header plus bindings[0..binding_count), pushes, push_bytes[0..push_bytes_length), constant_bytes[0..constant_length) and the spec's used counts. ZERO the remaining sections instead of copying them; that is write-only, half the traffic. The Rust plan is zero beyond its counts, so the host TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY full-struct memcmp stays exact.
   - Do not skip zeroing: callers reuse their buffers.
2) tegu_render_generic_snapshot_rt: 11% self + 11% memcpy per draw. Claim it on the board first: A3 works nearby in compositor_submit.inc.
3) tegu_command_job zeroing: ~13% of encode. sizeof(struct Dispatch) is large. Real gains need lazy per-entry zeroing (a chunk bitmap) or splitting rarely-used fields (compute wire2/v2 arrays, attachment-clear request) out of Dispatch.
4) Submit side: after today's fixes, the host submit fit is 1.39 us/job + 0.80 us/draw. The device's 270 us/job + 153 us/draw is therefore mostly kernel/memory: read TEGU_PERF_KCALL from the next device run before cutting more userspace.

TOOLS
- frame_bench: FB_PROF=<file> samples the execute phase (FB_PROF_ENCODE=1 samples encoding).
- frame_bench: FB_OFFSET_RING, FB_CA_LOOP with FB_SUBMIT_US/FB_GPU_US, FB_APSO.
- gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/tools/submit_cost.sh <tag> prints per-scenario exec and the per-job/per-draw fit.
- gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/tools/gates.sh runs the full host gate set (nice 10, waits for the heavy lease).
